picks.title: Maxon releases Cinema 4D 2026.4 with a new MCP Server
picks.excerpt: Cinema 4D 2026.4 adds an official MCP Server so Claude Desktop or ChatGPT Desktop can drive routine scene, render and rigging tasks via natural-language prompts; local, off by default, 'not a generative system'.
picks.rationale: Major DCC tool ships an official MCP bridge — directly changes 3D/motion designers' daily workflow; CG Channel chosen over Creative Bloq/DEVELOP3D (same story; Creative Bloq URL is also in movies' pool).

picks.title: Photoshop's controversial new AI tool is dividing opinion
picks.excerpt: Relight, a generative AI feature in Photoshop beta, strips an image's lighting and lets you add up to three controllable lights; early results split opinion over a 3D-avatar look. 30 credits per render.
picks.rationale: New Photoshop beta feature with hands-on usage details plus the craft debate — actionable for retouchers/visual designers.

picks.title: Introducing Runway Ads
picks.excerpt: Runway Ads connects an ad account and brand kit, generates video/image creative, publishes approved variants to Meta, Google and TikTok, reads performance back and produces the next round.
picks.rationale: Primary-source product launch that automates the creative-iteration loop for brand/marketing designers.

picks.title: OwlCAD brings parametric CAD and AI-powered design to the browser
picks.excerpt: Spare Matter's browser-based OwlCAD returns AI-described parts as editable parametric node trees; Pro plan adds AI and a hosted 29-tool MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and other agents.
picks.rationale: Text-to-CAD that keeps editable dimensions + agent MCP access — concrete for product/industrial designers; fills the CAD slot.

picks.title: AI Has Changed What Makes a Great Designer
picks.excerpt: Parsons professor Steven Faerm argues that as AI makes production abundant, organizations should hire and evaluate designers on problem framing and judgment, and decide deliberately where AI enters the process.
picks.rationale: Design-org (AX) perspective on hiring, reviews and junior development — directly relevant to a design organization's AI transformation.
